cohort: 243 patients who had peripartum hysterectomy at Kanuni Sultan Süleyman Training and Research Hospital, Istanbul, Turkey between January 2001 and September 2017
finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy increased from 0.67 per 1000 deliveries to 1.14 per 1000 deliveries between 2001-2008 and 2009-2017, with the main indication changing from uterine atony to placenta accreta spectrum.
